description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the RefreshTokenRepository component in an OAuth implementation within the OrangeHRM project. It tests creation, persistence, revocation, and status checking of refresh tokens, as well as ensuring proper handling of duplicate tokens and non-existent tokens.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepositoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class focusing on the behavior of RefreshTokenRepository, covering creation, storage, revocation, and error handling of OAuth refresh tokens within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, loading fixture data and instantiating the RefreshTokenRepository.

methods.name: testGetNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Verifies that the repository creates new instances of RefreshTokenEntity.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Tests persisting a new refresh token and verifies saved data correctness.

methods.name: testPersistNewAccessTokenWithExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Checks that attempting to persist a duplicate refresh token triggers a UniqueTokenIdentifierConstraintViolationException.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures a refresh token can be revoked and its revoked state is correctly updated.

methods.name: testRevokeAccessTokenWhichAlreadyRevoked
methods.description: Verifies that revoking an already revoked token does not change its state.

methods.name: testRevokeNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to revoke a non-existent refresh token fails silently without error.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks that the system correctly reports whether specific refresh tokens are revoked.

methods.name: testIsAccessTokenRevokedForNonExistingAccessToken
methods.description: Verifies that a non-existent token is reported as revoked.
